label: Ripe today
explanation: Ripe products sell fastest. Putting them out now means customers buy them before they go soft.

label: In storage
explanation: There is enough in the back room to fill the display, so you won't have an empty spot again in an hour.

label: Same price range
explanation: Customers who came for the promo expect a similar price. A much more expensive product feels like a bait and switch.

label: Same type of product
explanation: Shoppers look for products by group. Berries next to berries keeps the display easy to understand.

label: Fits the display
explanation: The product size and packaging fit this table, so it looks full with the amount suggested.

label: Waste risk
explanation: This product spoils soon. Placing it on a busy promo display helps it sell before it has to be thrown away.
